Subject: Salta Foods — MX tax residency & PO setup

Hi Carlos,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get Salta onboarded. Finance and Procurement have a couple of requirements we need to close before we activate a PO and begin monthly consumption billing. Can you confirm/provide the following?

- Legal entity full name as it should appear on the PO and invoice (including accents).
- RFC (Mexican tax ID) and a signed/dated Constancia de Situación Fiscal (tax residency / status document).
- Sample CFDI (XML) for a recent sale so our AP team can validate the UUID, seal and concept lines.
- Bank wiring instructions (bank name, CLABE or SWIFT as applicable, beneficiary legal name).
- Clarify whether Salta will invoice with IVA (VAT) included or as a separate line and whether you expect Redwood to withhold any ISR/withholding taxes for non-resident payments.
- Preferred invoice currency (MXN / USD) and any PO-level references we should include (cost center, legal contact).

If you can drop the files into the shared folder linked below or attach them to your reply, Procurement will start the PO mapping and Finance will confirm withholding status. Our typical PO activation timeline after docs arrive is 3–5 business days.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-salta-onboarding

Thanks — I can run interference with AP if anything needs clarification.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0124

Hi Ben — thanks for the checklist. Attached are the documents you requested:

- CONSTANCIA_FISCAL_SALTA.pdf (Constancia de Situación Fiscal, issued 2027-05-02)
- sample_cfdi_invoice.xml (CFDI 4.0 example, includes UUID and sello)
- bank_details_salta.pdf (local bank CLABE and correspondent SWIFT)

Clarifications:
- Legal name: Salta Foods S.A. de C.V. (please include the full punctuation on the PO).
- RFC: SFT720614M9A
- We invoice with IVA (16%) as a separate line on the CFDI.
- For services rendered to a US-based buyer, Mexico does not generally require ISR withholding by the payer if the provider is providing services from Mexico to a foreign entity — however, specific withholding can apply in some cases depending on the service type and if there is a PE. We normally do not expect Redwood to withhold; we will issue invoices net of any withholding.
- We can invoice in MXN or in USD (we generally prefer MXN). Please let us know what works for Redwood.

Files attached to this reply. Let me know if AP needs anything else (certificate translations, notarized docs).

Saludos,
Carlos Méndez

Thanks Carlos — that's perfect and much appreciated. Next steps from our side:

1) Procurement will create a PO using the exact legal name and RFC you provided. Please confirm the billing address line you want on the PO (we can use the address on the Constancia if that's easiest).
2) Finance will validate the CFDI XML against our AP rules (UUID, sello, tax breakdown). If all good, we will not apply any withholding on our first payment; AP will confirm in the PO notes.
3) Please tell us whether invoices will include a single invoice number per CFDI (preferred) or multiple line-level UUIDs (if you use sub-invoice constructs).
4) We will create a mutual action plan for activation and target PO issue by end of week (Fri 18 Jun) if no blockers.

I added a short PO instruction doc for AP in the shared Drive (see link below) and routed the files to AP for review. If AP flags any missing fields we'll loop you back in.
